name: North Haven, Maine
historical_notes: Island community central to the archive. Earlier records may describe the north island under Vinalhaven. The pin represents the modern municipality; no home or wireless station is located here.

name: Vinalhaven, Maine
historical_notes: Early municipal and legislative records concern a jurisdiction that also included the north island before separation. This modern point is a geographic reference, not a town hall or a reconstruction of former town boundaries.

name: Pulpit Harbor
historical_notes: The 1848 act authorized a bridge across the head of this harbor to land of James and Josiah Beverage. The same harbor appears in Frank Beverage’s 1927 auction notice. The NOAA reference point does not identify either historic property or the proposed bridge.
coordinate_notes: Rounded modern reference point from the cited geographic source.
